description: This file contains a test utility class 'TestRxSchedulers' for managing and simulating RxJava schedulers and Robolectric shadow looper behaviors in unit tests for the 'com.anysoftkeyboard.rx' package.

classes.name: TestRxSchedulers
classes.description: A utility class for testing RxJava schedulers and Robolectric looper behaviors, providing methods to manipulate and verify scheduled tasks in unit tests.

methods.name: setSchedulers
methods.description: Sets the main thread looper and background executor service for testing.

methods.name: foregroundHasMoreJobs
methods.description: Checks if there are more scheduled tasks in the main looper.

methods.name: foregroundFlushAllJobs
methods.description: Runs and flushes all scheduled foreground jobs up to a maximum number of drains.

methods.name: foregroundRunOneJob
methods.description: Runs the next scheduled foreground job if available.

methods.name: foregroundAdvanceBy
methods.description: Advances the main looper by a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: backgroundHasQueuedJobs
methods.description: Checks if there are queued background tasks.

methods.name: backgroundFlushAllJobs
methods.description: Runs all queued background jobs up to a maximum number of drains.

methods.name: backgroundRunOneJob
methods.description: Runs the next background job if available.

methods.name: drainAllTasks
methods.description: Runs all foreground and background tasks up to a maximum number of drains.

methods.name: drainAllTasksUntilEnd
methods.description: Continuously drains all foreground and background tasks until none remain.

methods.name: blockingGet
methods.description: Blocks until the Single emits a value, draining tasks in the meantime.

methods.name: destroySchedulers
methods.description: Shuts down and cleans up the schedulers and executor services.
